passages.text: Echium simplex, commonly known as pride of Tenerife or tower of jewels, is an herbaceous biennial plant which grows up to {{cvt|3|m}} in height.

Habitat
It is a frost intolerant species requiring sustained periods of sunlight to thrive. It is endemic in the island of Tenerife mainly in Macizo de Anaga.{{cn|date=March 2026}}

Description
The plant is biennial producing a dense rosette in the first year and producing the distinctive inflorescence to a height of {{convert|1|–|3|m}} during the second year. The flowers are white and the plant is in bloom from February to April in Tenerife. E. simplex is widely available as a garden flower in warm temperate areas. It is very attractive to bees and produces a distinctively flavored honey.{{cn|date=March 2026}}
